meta.bgm_decision: No license-clean REAL morna recording exists on any documented rung: Wikimedia Commons audio ('morna'/'Cape Verde'/'saudade'/'coladeira'/'cavaquinho' — only 1-second pronunciation clips), Openverse audio (Jamendo/Freesound/wikimedia aggregate — no allowlisted morna; the only 'Saudade'-titled Commons track is a future-garage electronic piece, wrong genre), Free Music Archive (zero results for 'morna'), and Internet Archive (the only Cape Verdean-music items are unauthorized rips of copyrighted Cesária Évora albums — NOT laundered — plus a BY-NC-ND radio show, and 1930s Cape Verdean-American 78s are not yet public domain under the US Music Modernization Act). All Cesária Évora studio recordings are © Lusafrica/Sony. The rung-2 copyrighted demo self-host was deliberately NOT used (this premium run targets publication; a publish-blocked BGM would gate it). Chosen: rung-C license-clean floor with maximum mood/instrument fit — 'Romance Anónimo' (Spanish Romance), a CC0 Musopen RECORDING (recording license verified, not just the PD-ish composition) of the most famous melancholic solo-GUITAR piece in the repertoire: guitar is morna's core instrument and the piece's quiet longing matches 'sodade'. The REAL morna is still on the page: the Detective's oEmbed-verified official YouTube embeds inst_01 ('Sodade') and inst_03 ('Petit pays') give readers Cesária Évora herself in context.
gaps_for_editor: Sidny Lopes Cabral (103' scorer): NO license-clean, identity-verifiable photo exists — Wikidata Q124382289 has no P18, Wikimedia Commons search is empty, Openverse search is empty. Per detective.json meta.scout_brief escalation: do NOT use an unlicensed press photo; lean on the verified Deroy Duarte photo (sct_09) + the FOX highlights embed (inst_02) for the goal-scorer visuals. Recorded honestly as a gap.

Cape Verde fan-CELEBRATION crowds (Brockton watch parties / Praia street scenes, WC2026): no license-clean photos on Commons/Openverse as of 2026-07-04 (only Uganda fans from a 2016 qualifier). Best available substitute is sct_03 — Rotterdam's Nieuwe Binnenweg dressed in Cape Verdean flags for the World Cup (2026-06-23), which lands the diaspora-street-pride beat and directly matches the Rotterdam spine (det_05/det_10).
Match-night action photos from Miami Stadium 2026-07-03: none license-clean; the venue is covered by the verified aerial (sct_04) and the match by the FOX embed (inst_02).
meta.video_leads_not_registered: Wikimedia Commons hosts several teleSUR .webm news clips on Cape Verde at WC2026 (e.g. 'LA PELOTA NO SE MANCHA - Mundo en el Mundial - Cabo Verde- Cultura, sodade y fútbol 15-06-2026.webm', a Vozinha interview, Spain 0-0 report). Not registered: each would need frame_verify + weight budget; the story already has three oEmbed-verified YouTube embeds. Designer may request one if a video beat is missing.

live_status.subject: 2026 World Cup status for the story's protagonists (Cape Verde eliminated; Argentina's next fixture)
live_status.status: As of 4 July 2026: Cape Verde's tournament is over — eliminated in the Round of 32 by Argentina, 3-2 after extra time, at Miami Stadium on 3 July (the winner an own-goal deflection in the 111th minute). Argentina advance to a Round-of-16 tie against Egypt (who beat Australia 4-2 on penalties, their first-ever knockout win) on 7 July 2026 at Atlanta Stadium, 16:00 GMT. Cape Verde exit as the smallest nation ever to reach a World Cup knockout round, unbeaten in 90 minutes across all four matches.
